# Sai Coaters and Fabricators

> Sai Coaters and Fabricators is a contract manufacturer in MIDC Ambad, Nashik, India, making pressed, fabricated and powder-coated components for automotive and electrical OEMs since 2002. Part of the SCF Group (Rs 52.26 Cr revenue FY 2025-26). Approved source by Mahindra & Mahindra.

The group also supplies ABB India, BHEL, Gabriel India, Lauritz Knudsen, KPIT, Sharda Motors and Sipra Engineers. All processes are in-house across two Nashik plants (F-133 and G-37, MIDC Ambad): tool room, turret punching and bending, laser cutting and laser welding, press shop (40 to 300 tonne mechanical presses, including a SEYI SNX-110), fabrication, powder coating, and control panel assembly with wiring.

## What buyers use us for
- Pressed and stamped components, 40T to 300T press range
- Sheet metal fabrication and welded assemblies to drawing
- Industrial powder coating (conveyorised line) and coating job work
- Control panels: fabricated, coated, wired and assembled
- Mono-polar and bi-polar plates for hydrogen fuel cell programs
- Breaker shafts and welded assemblies for switchgear OEMs
- Shock absorber outer tubes and suspension components
- Locomotive components, base frames, core stampings, side assemblies
- Turnkey paint shop and powder coating plant projects
- Galvanised filters for GDC and LPDC plants

## How to buy
- RFQ with drawing upload (STEP, DXF, DWG, PDF): 24-hour engineer response
- NDA signed before drawing review when requested
- Quality objectives: on-time delivery, 85% OEE, zero customer complaints
